design_notes: All 25 research queries are strictly separated from the 5 development queries. Includes 23 PubMed-GEO linked studies and 2 literature-only negative controls (BENCH-23, BENCH-24).

questions.query: Single-cell RNA sequencing intratumoral heterogeneity in primary glioblastoma
questions.expected_evidence: We used single-cell RNA-seq to profile 430 cells from five primary glioblastomas and uncovered inherent intratumoral heterogeneity in oncogenic signaling.
questions.reference_answer: Single-cell RNA sequencing of 430 cells across five primary human glioblastomas (GSE57872, PMID 24925914) reveals mosaic expression of receptor tyrosine kinases including EGFR and PDGFRA.

questions.query: Gene expression profiling of acute myeloid leukemia with FLT3-ITD mutations
questions.expected_evidence: Gene-expression profiling of 285 patients with acute myeloid leukemia identified distinct molecular clusters associated with FLT3 internal tandem duplications.
questions.reference_answer: Microarray profiling of 285 AML patient samples (GSE1159, PMID 15077127) stratifies acute myeloid leukemia into reproducible prognostic subtypes linked to FLT3 and CEBPA alterations.

questions.query: Transcriptional profiling of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis lung tissue
questions.expected_evidence: Transcriptional profiling of lung tissues from 119 idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis patients revealed upregulation of extracellular matrix remodeling genes including MMP7 and COL1A1.
questions.reference_answer: Lung tissue transcriptomics in 119 IPF cases (GSE32537, PMID 21974901) demonstrates robust activation of TGF-beta and extracellular matrix remodeling genes such as MMP7 and COL1A1.

questions.query: Type I interferon gene expression signature in systemic lupus erythematosus

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Peripheral blood mononuclear cell microarray analysis

questions.expected_evidence: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with systemic lupus erythematosus exhibit a prominent type I interferon-inducible gene expression signature.
questions.reference_answer: PBMC expression profiling in systemic lupus erythematosus (GSE4588, PMID 12601032) identifies a conserved type I interferon signature driven by IFI27, IFIT1, and MX1.

questions.query: Substantia nigra gene expression changes in sporadic Parkinson disease
questions.expected_evidence: Gene expression analysis of postmortem substantia nigra tissue from Parkinson disease patients demonstrated downregulation of dopaminergic transmission genes.
questions.reference_answer: Postmortem substantia nigra transcriptomics in sporadic Parkinson disease (GSE7621, PMID 16344956) shows reduced expression of dopaminergic pathway transcripts alongside mitochondrial stress.

questions.query: Transcriptomic subtyping of microsatellite instability in colorectal cancer
questions.expected_evidence: Consensus molecular subtyping of colorectal cancer integrated transcriptomic datasets including GSE39582 to define the MSI immune subtype CMS1.
questions.reference_answer: Multi-cohort colorectal cancer transcriptomics incorporating GSE39582 (PMID 26457759) defines four consensus molecular subtypes, linking MSI-high tumors to strong immune infiltration.

questions.query: Tubulointerstitial gene expression in diabetic chronic kidney disease

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Microdissected glomeruli and tubuli microarray profiling

questions.expected_evidence: Microarray analysis of microdissected human diabetic kidney samples in GSE30122 identified complement activation and fibrotic pathway enrichment.
questions.reference_answer: Microdissected renal compartment profiling in diabetic nephropathy (GSE30122, PMID 21752957) reveals prominent complement cascade and extracellular matrix gene induction.

questions.query: Whole-blood host transcriptomic response in pediatric septic shock
questions.expected_evidence: Genome-wide expression profiling of whole blood from children with septic shock (GSE13904) revealed repression of adaptive immunity genes and innate inflammation activation.
questions.reference_answer: Whole-blood transcriptomics in pediatric septic shock (GSE13904, PMID 19325468) demonstrates coordinated innate immune activation and suppression of T-cell receptor signaling.

questions.query: Transcriptomic predictors of anti-PD-1 checkpoint blockade response in metastatic melanoma
questions.expected_evidence: Transcriptomic analysis of pretreatment melanoma biopsies (GSE78220) identified an innate anti-PD-1 resistance signature enriched in mesenchymal and wound-healing genes.
questions.reference_answer: RNA-seq of pretreatment metastatic melanoma tumors (GSE78220, PMID 26997480) associates innate anti-PD-1 resistance with an IPRES transcriptional signature.

questions.query: Stromal and tumor molecular subtypes in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Virtual microdissection of primary and metastatic PDAC microarrays

questions.expected_evidence: Virtual microdissection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma gene expression data (GSE71729) identified basal-like and classical tumor subtypes alongside normal and activated stroma.
questions.reference_answer: Transcriptomic deconvolution of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (GSE71729, PMID 26343385) separates tumor-intrinsic classical/basal subtypes from stromal subtypes.

questions.query: Myocardial gene expression remodeling in human dilated cardiomyopathy
questions.expected_evidence: Expression profiling of failing human left ventricular myocardium (GSE5406) demonstrated consistent upregulation of natriuretic peptides NPPA and NPPB.
questions.reference_answer: Human failing myocardium transcriptomics (GSE5406, PMID 24565855) reveals conserved fetal gene program reactivation including NPPA, NPPB, and sarcomeric remodeling.

questions.query: Airway epithelial gene expression signatures in severe asthma
questions.expected_evidence: Gene expression profiling of bronchial epithelial cells from asthma patients (GSE43696) identified Th2-high and Th2-low molecular endotypes.
questions.reference_answer: Bronchial epithelial transcriptomics in asthma (GSE43696, PMID 23601105) stratifies patients by Th2 inflammation markers POSTN, CLCA1, and SERPINB2.

questions.query: Nasopharyngeal host transcriptional response to SARS-CoV-2 infection

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Bulk RNA sequencing of infected respiratory cells and patient samples

questions.expected_evidence: Transcriptional profiling of SARS-CoV-2 infection models and patient samples (GSE147507) showed reduced type I/III interferon induction alongside elevated chemokine expression.
questions.reference_answer: Host transcriptomic profiling of SARS-CoV-2 infection (GSE147507, PMID 32416070) demonstrates an imbalanced antiviral response characterized by low IFN-I/III and high CXCL10/IL6.

questions.query: Transcriptional dynamics during human induced pluripotent stem cell reprogramming
questions.expected_evidence: Time-course expression profiling during somatic cell reprogramming (GSE21757) delineated sequential mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition and pluripotency network activation.
questions.reference_answer: Reprogramming time-course transcriptomics (GSE21757, PMID 20473322) maps early suppression of somatic genes followed by activation of POU5F1, SOX2, and NANOG.

questions.query: Colonic mucosal gene expression in ulcerative colitis anti-TNF therapy resistance

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Colonic mucosal biopsy microarray profiling before and after infliximab

questions.expected_evidence: Mucosal gene expression profiling in inflammatory bowel disease patients treated with infliximab (GSE16879) identified predictive signatures of anti-TNF non-response.
questions.reference_answer: Mucosal biopsy profiling before and after infliximab therapy (GSE16879, PMID 19956723) identifies inflammatory gene signatures distinguishing responders from non-responders.

questions.query: Subcutaneous adipose tissue transcriptomics in human insulin resistance
questions.expected_evidence: Subcutaneous adipose tissue expression profiling (GSE27951) revealed macrophage inflammatory infiltration and downregulation of mitochondrial oxidative genes in insulin-resistant subjects.
questions.reference_answer: Human adipose tissue transcriptomics (GSE27951, PMID 21378177) links insulin resistance to macrophage chemokine CCL2 induction and reduced adiponectin expression.

questions.query: Gene expression profiling of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma progression

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Oligonucleotide microarray analysis of actinic keratosis and SCC

questions.expected_evidence: Gene expression analysis comparing normal skin, actinic keratosis, and invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (GSE2503) highlighted keratinocyte hyperproliferation markers.
questions.reference_answer: Transcriptomic profiling across skin carcinogenesis stages (GSE2503, PMID 21576308) identifies progressive upregulation of S100A8, KRT16, and matrix metalloproteinases.

questions.query: Transcriptional landscape of human regulatory T cells versus conventional CD4+ T cells
questions.expected_evidence: Gene expression profiling of Foxp3+ regulatory T cells (GSE6566) defined the core Foxp3-dependent transcriptional program governing immune suppression.
questions.reference_answer: Expression analysis of sorted Foxp3+ Tregs (GSE6566, PMID 17277771) establishes the Foxp3-regulated signature including Il2ra and Ctla4.

questions.query: Molecular subtypes and survival signatures in high-grade serous ovarian cancer

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Microarray expression profiling of 285 ovarian tumors

questions.expected_evidence: Expression profiling of 285 serous and endometrioid ovarian tumors (GSE9891) identified novel molecular subtypes predictive of patient survival.
questions.reference_answer: Ovarian tumor microarray profiling of 285 cases (GSE9891, PMID 18698038) defines six molecular subtypes with distinct stromal and survival characteristics.

questions.query: Skeletal muscle transcriptomic response to aerobic endurance exercise training

expected_extractions.disease_or_condition: Skeletal muscle adaptation to endurance exercise
expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy microarray profiling

questions.expected_evidence: Skeletal muscle biopsy gene expression profiling before and after endurance training (GSE18583) identified an extracellular matrix remodeling signature correlating with VO2max gains.
questions.reference_answer: Human vastus lateralis transcriptomics (GSE18583, PMID 20107036) links aerobic capacity gains to coordinated angiogenesis and extracellular matrix remodeling.

questions.query: Integrative genomic and transcriptomic profiling of primary and metastatic prostate cancer

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Exon microarray and copy-number profiling of 218 prostate tumors

questions.expected_evidence: Integrative genomic profiling of 218 primary and metastatic prostate cancer samples (GSE21032) demonstrated ubiquitous androgen receptor pathway alterations in metastases.
questions.reference_answer: Integrative profiling of 218 prostate tumors (GSE21032, PMID 20579941) highlights recurrent AR pathway activation, TMPRSS2-ERG fusion, and PTEN loss.

questions.query: Retinal pigment epithelium and choroid gene expression in age-related macular degeneration

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Human donor retina and RPE-choroid microarray profiling

questions.expected_evidence: Genome-wide expression profiling of human macular and extramacular RPE-choroid tissues (GSE29801) implicated complement and immune-response genes in age-related macular degeneration.
questions.reference_answer: Human ocular tissue transcriptomics (GSE29801, PMID 22253606) reveals localized complement cascade and inflammatory gene enrichment in macular degeneration.

questions.query: Clinical trial outcomes of metformin monotherapy in newly diagnosed gestational diabetes
questions.expected_evidence: In women with gestational diabetes mellitus, metformin was not associated with increased perinatal complications compared with insulin.
questions.reference_answer: Randomized clinical trial of 751 women with gestational diabetes (PMID 18463376) demonstrates comparable perinatal safety for metformin versus insulin with no associated GEO expression dataset.

questions.query: CRISPR-Cas9 base editing mechanism without high-throughput expression dataset

expected_extractions.organism: Escherichia coli and Homo sapiens cells
expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Cytidine deaminase-dCas9 fusion protein engineering and Sanger/amplicon sequencing

questions.expected_evidence: We engineered fusions of CRISPR-Cas9 and a cytidine deaminase enzyme that mediate the direct conversion of cytidine to uridine without double-stranded DNA breaks.
questions.reference_answer: Programmable base editing using APOBEC1-dCas9 fusions (PMID 27096365) enables direct C-to-T conversion without double-strand breaks and has no associated GEO microarray/RNA-seq dataset.

questions.query: Gene expression profiling of BRAF V600E mutated papillary thyroid carcinoma

expected_extractions.experimental_methodology: Paired tumor and normal thyroid microarray profiling

questions.expected_evidence: Gene expression profiling of paired papillary thyroid carcinoma and normal thyroid tissues (GSE3467) revealed overexpression of MET, FN1, and MAPK pathway targets.
questions.reference_answer: Paired tumor-normal thyroid transcriptomics (GSE3467, PMID 16365291) identifies robust MAPK target induction including MET and FN1.
